title: Meteorology
description: Weather is heat engine and spinning world together: warm, moist air rises, cools and rains out its water, and the Earth's turning bends every wind sideways. A storm's updraft tears charge apart until the air breaks down in lightning, which fixes nitrogen as it goes. Unlocks the Storm Chamber.

puzzle.goal: On a world turning at angular speed Ω, a wind at latitude φ is bent sideways by the Coriolis effect; how strongly is set by the Coriolis parameter, twice the spin's component along the local vertical. Write f.
puzzle.name: The Coriolis parameter
puzzle.ask: Find f in 1/s: Ω = @{Ω} rad/s, φ = @{φ} rad.
puzzle.method: The local vertical makes angle (90° − φ) with the spin axis; the Coriolis acceleration is 2Ω sinφ times the wind speed.
